comment: Self-hosted financial data MCP server. Run locally via Docker:
Web portal: http://localhost:8080  |  MCP SSE: http://localhost:8081/sse
Form 3/4 insider trades, congressional disclosures, FINRA short volume,
SEC fails-to-deliver, FRED economic indicators, CFTC futures, CBOE VIX/put-call,
daily prices + technical indicators. No cloud dependency, no API keys required.
Set mcp.equibles.enabled: true in config.yaml once the container is running.

openresearch.comment: Phase 7 (planned): exposes run_stock_research, run_board_session, run_interview_prep as MCP tools
